kilauea_notices.title: HAWAIIAN VOLCANO OBSERVATORY DAILY UPDATE
kilauea_notices.message: HVO Kilauea ORANGE/WATCH - Numerous rapid cycles of south vent overflows and drainback occurred overnight within Halema'uma'u crater at the summit of Kīlauea. The north and south vents had strong glow and intermittent spatter. There is no anomalous activity outside of the summit.

mauna_loa_notices.title: HAWAIIAN VOLCANO OBSERVATORY MONTHLY UPDATE
mauna_loa_notices.message: HVO Haleakala GREEN/NORMAL - No activity of concern for Haleakalā.
